title: When the Cover Burns
author: O. M. Nystrom
blurb: Noor Galloway, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
